title: Rice Pilaf
description: Fluffy long-grain rice toasted in butter with toasted pasta and onion, then simmered in broth. Every grain stays separate.
equipment: Medium saucepan with a tight lid

image.alt: A bowl of golden rice pilaf with toasted noodles and parsley

steps.text: Melt the butter in the saucepan over medium heat. Add the pasta and stir until golden brown, {time 2-3 min}.
Add the onion and cook until soft, {time 3 min}. Add the rice and stir until the grains look translucent at the edges, {time 2 min}.
Pour in the broth and salt and bring to a boil. Cover tightly, turn the heat to low and simmer until the liquid is absorbed, {time 18 min}.
Take the pan off the heat and let it stand, still covered, for {time 5 min}. Fluff with a fork and stir in the parsley.

notes: Use vegetable broth to make it vegetarian.
